privacy.adatok.leiras: Everything stays on this Mac. Nothing is uploaded.
privacy.adatok.memoria_tetelek: learned items stored on this Mac
privacy.adatok.nincs_modell_leiras: AI features are optional. Models are downloaded only when you choose to install them.
privacy.asszisztens.leiras: The assistant suggests links, tags and templates based on what you accept. It learns on this Mac only; review or delete what it learned under AI, then Memory.
privacy.engedelyek.leiras: Permissions are granted by macOS. Manifold asks only when you use a feature that needs one.
privacy.halozat.engedett.runtime_tools: Install extra tools (for example the C++ toolchain)
privacy.halozat.engedett.video_links: Download videos from links you give
privacy.halozat.leiras: Manifold works offline. It uses the network only for downloads you start yourself.
privacy.halozat.nincs_letoltes_leiras: When you download a model or a video, it is listed here.
privacy.halozat.offline_be: Offline mode is on: nothing is sent or fetched in the background.
privacy.halozat.offline_ki: Offline mode is off for this session. Check the app installation.
privacy.hely.backup_leiras: Text backups of your workspace on this Mac.
privacy.hely.models_leiras: Downloaded models. They can be downloaded again.
privacy.hely.personal_leiras: Usage statistics and calendar information, stored on this Mac only.
privacy.hely.snapshots_leiras: Safety copies taken before each change so you can undo it.
privacy.hely.workspace_leiras: Your Markdown notes and attachments. Other apps can open this folder too.
privacy.integraciok.leiras: Choose which features may connect to other parts of macOS. Changes apply after you save.
privacy.integraciok.naptar_javitas: Reinstall Manifold or open it from the installed app, then check again.
privacy.integraciok.naptar_nem_elerheto: Calendar & Reminders is turned on, but the calendar helper is not available.
privacy.memoria.be: The assistant is learning on this Mac.
privacy.memoria.ki: The assistant is off, so it is not learning.
privacy.memoria.leiras: Everything the assistant learned is listed here. Delete an item and it forgets it.
privacy.nem_elerheto_javitas: Check that Manifold is still running, then try again.
privacy.telemetria.leiras: Manifold has no remote telemetry. The tracker keeps usage statistics on this Mac only, and you can export or delete them.
